title: AI Mode
content: AI Mode is a Google Search experience for exploring questions through AI responses and follow-up questions, with links to supporting websites.

meta.why: An opening question and its follow-up can require different information from your site.
meta.example: A buyer asks about inventory software, then adds that the business sells through multiple stores.
meta.check: Test an initial buyer question along with a realistic follow-up, then save the sources and the requirements each answer addresses.
meta.limitation: Availability and behavior can change, which means one appearance in one response does not establish a stable position.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: AI features and your website | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features | Platform documentation
